positions.name: OwnedIntelligenceAsRetainedAsset
positions.frame: When intelligence can be owned or rented, where does the durable value sit — in the commoditized substrate, or in the perspective retained by the owner?
positions.why: Both expressions are aphoristic maxims built on matched opposition (owned/rented; commodity/asset) that locate durable value in what is retained rather than what is exchanged. The register pass reads both as the same plain-spoken/technical maxim move; the relational pass reads both under market-pricing with an asset-retention framing; the value pass reads both as appeals to autonomy and self-possession. Conviction differs slightly in strength — src-2 lands as an unhedged claim, src-3 as a near-principle, creed-like formulation — but this is a gradient within one continuous framing move, not a rupture: src-3 sharpens the distinction src-2 opens rather than departing from it.

positions.name: SelfReferentialPositioningNote
positions.frame: What is this text's own function and provenance within the navigation/positioning pipeline it names itself as part of?
positions.why: Both expressions describe the document's own role rather than asserting substantive content about intelligence or value — src-1 labels itself 'a positioning note used by the navigation/provenance regression guard,' src-4 explains it 'restates the individually-owned-intelligence thesis so a navigating extractor has existing positioning to connect to.' Both share the same footing (animator=author=Xena ExpertGH, principal=null, fc-1), both read as floated 'notion' rather than committed claim in the conviction pass, and both sit at present/realis/abstract describing the text's own function rather than an event or a stance — a meta-level, self-referential coherence distinct from the substantive maxims in the other group.

placements.title: Durable value relocates from the commoditized substrate to the retained perspective
placements.frame: When intelligence can be owned or rented, does the expression locate the durable value in what is kept (perspective) rather than in what is exchanged or commoditized (substrate)?
placements.why: src-2 ('Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence') and src-3 ('The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep') are matched aphoristic maxims that together state a single thesis: durable value sits in retained perspective, not in the commoditized substrate through which intelligence is delivered. This is genuinely narrative-grain — a directional claim about where value sits, not a one-time fact or measurement — and the position pass already grouped these two segments as one coherent thesis (OwnedIntelligenceAsRetainedAsset) built on the same market-pricing/asset-retention/autonomy framing across the register, relational, and value passes. The supplied graph structure and strata are both empty, so nothing existing can hold this theme; per the freeze rule a new leaf is minted rather than forcing a paraphrased reuse. No strata category is minted alongside it because the content here is a single aphoristic positioning note, not evidence of a recurring organizational category — inventing a strata parent from this thin, self-declared 'regression guard' probe would be over-minting.
